2026_03_SEA_WAS.headline: Seattle prepares for Marcus Mariota as Washington adjusts without Jayden Daniels
2026_03_SEA_WAS.paragraph1: Washington will start Marcus Mariota after Jayden Daniels dislocated his left elbow against Dallas, forcing the Commanders to recalibrate their offense for the home matchup. Mariota was efficient in relief, but Seattle can now prepare a full game plan around his tendencies. The Seahawks should lean on their defensive structure to limit easy quarterback runs and force sustained drives, while Washington needs its run game and quick passing concepts to keep Mariota out of obvious passing situations.
2026_03_SEA_WAS.model_rationale: Washington’s quarterback change shifts the matchup toward execution and protection, while Seattle can benefit by forcing Mariota to sustain long drives rather than creating easy explosive opportunities.
